english.note: Use this more formal or general term for the place someone regards as their native home.
Use this for one's native land or hometown rather than the house one currently lives in.

examples.english: I have always missed my hometown.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 gaa1 hoeng1

examples.english: When I retire, I'll go back home to live in my hometown.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teoi3 jau1 zau6 faan1 gaa1 hoeng1 zyu6
